Under the rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3): the Faculty Handbook (July 1, 2016 edition, in force on the reference date) is a governing faculty handbook covering tenure-stream faculty, with a leave-of-absence section (6.7) and a tenure-clock provision (3.2.2), so missing is false. It contains no parental, maternity or modified-duties provision; the childbirth benefits come only from the two HR benefit pages, which point to governing policies that are not saved (the Parental Leave policy, the FMLA policy, the Sick Pay, Short and Long Term Disability policy).

Version: the two HR pages are Wayback captures of 2019 (footers 3/26/2019 and 2/6/2019), outside the 2017-18 reference year, so their components carry version_uncertain; both pages state the paid parental leave is effective for events on or after 2017-11-01, i.e. before the reference date.

Summary vs governing document: the HR pages are summaries ('See the policy'). summary_only was not applied because the governing policies are not saved, so it cannot be shown that the governing document lacks the provision; the components are flagged ambiguous and cross_reference_not_saved instead. This remains an open point.

Chain, birth parent: short-term disability maternity leave 6 (max 8) weeks at 100% (c2) → paid parental leave 2 weeks at 100% (c1, consecutive_after c2, birth role) → unpaid FMLA remainder; FMLA (c3) concurrent with c2 from the start, 12 weeks in all; leave limit 12 weeks on FMLA + parental leave.
Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave 2 weeks at 100% (c1) with FMLA (c3) concurrent from its start → unpaid FMLA remainder to 12 weeks.

Not components: Faculty Handbook 6.7 university-sponsored paid leaves through the Quality of Instruction Council and University Research Council (competitive research/teaching leaves for projects; a parent could not take them for a birth); Handbook 2.1 equal-opportunity statement naming parental status; Handbook 2.6.1 probationary extension on change of affiliation (not leave-related).

Documents cited but not saved: DePaul Parental Leave policy ('See the policy', HR page); DePaul Family and Medical Leave Act policy (HR page, Handbook 4.8); Sick Pay, Short and Long Term Disability policy (Handbook 4.8); university policy on leaves for medical need or disability (Handbook 6.7); Quality of Instruction Council and University Research Council leave guidelines (Handbook 6.7); college or departmental leave programmes (Handbook 6.7); Floating Holiday/Vacation/Parental Leave election form; Anti-Discrimination and Anti-Harassment Policy, Records Management policy, Faculty Council bylaws, unit tenure guidelines (not leave-related).

Handbook 4.8 gives tenured faculty on long-term disability a right to resume the position within 36 months of the first day of short-term disability leave (c6); coded with faculty_group 'tenured faculty' because tenure-track faculty are not covered.
The 6 vs 8 weeks of the maternity short-term disability period: the page does not state what decides which.

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
